name: BSP_MissionScoring_NotifyEntity
evidence: Hypothesis, not a recovered symbol, and provisional. __fastcall(Entity*), RET at 0092802a. Called from 00906460 for every world entity whose +180h dword is <= 7. Stamps the clock 00f876a4 into entity+1D0h and, when entity+9D4h holds a formation whose +3CCh count is positive, writes the same value into up to five members' +1D0h; then calls 0090ed40 when virtual +5Ch(5) holds. Reads as an AI re-target kick; the behaviour is not established. docs/MISSION_RESULT_DECISION.md.

name: BSP_UnitController_ApproachAxialSpeed
evidence: Hypothesis, not a recovered symbol. void __thiscall(controller, float commanded_speed, float dt) RET 8. Rewrites the body's linear velocity toward a commanded forward speed with an acceleration limit; commanded thrust is kinematic, not a force. dir is the body axis flattened to the horizontal (the y term is a literal 0.0f/len at 0092D3B7), target = (1-|axis.y|)*commanded, accel from 00825EC0 unless one of three class[504h] cases fires, move = accel*dt bites only while it is no larger than the gap, then 00C37E50. Sole caller 00825F20. docs/UNIT_FORCE_COMMANDS.md

name: BSP_UnitController_GetBodyAxisSpeed
evidence: Hypothesis, not a recovered symbol. float __thiscall(controller), RET 0, body 0092D730..0092D76E, result on the x87 stack. body=controller->p_2Ch; axis=00C32000(body); v=00C31F40(body,&scratch); return (v[1]*axis[1Ch] + v[0]*axis[18h]) + v[2]*axis[20h]. axis+18h..+20h is the third 12-byte row, so this is a signed speed along one body axis. Whole sum stays on the x87 stack and is rounded once at 0092D765. 28 callers including 008255B0, 008252C0 and 00834E90. docs/UNIT_TIMED_SUBUPDATES.md

name: BSP_UnitController_SetAxialSpeed
evidence: Hypothesis, not a recovered symbol. void __thiscall(controller, float speed) RET 4. Replaces the component of the body's linear velocity along the body axis outright, with no rate limit and no heel scale, using 00C32000's basis unnormalised: v' = v - dot(v,axis)*axis + speed*axis, then 00C37E50 at 0092D8 4D. Callers 0081F980 and 00822C20, both spawn or reset paths. docs/UNIT_FORCE_COMMANDS.md | The 00C37E50 call site is 0092D84D.

name: BSP_UnitController_ApplySteering
evidence: Hypothesis, not a recovered symbol. void __thiscall(controller, float to_turn, float dt) RET 8. The rudder half of the command path, and like the throttle half it writes a velocity rather than a force: 0042AC60 rate-limits controller+80h toward to_turn with dt*0.5f (00D7A280) at 0092E8EF, 00811890 maps the smoothed rudder to a yaw rate (negated at 0092E955), 00825DE0 adds the propeller assist, and 00C37E20 sets the angular velocity at 0092EB8F. The decomposition at 0092E96F..0092EB8F and its roll damper are analysed, not reconstructed. Sole caller 00825F20. docs/UNIT_FORCE_COMMANDS.md
